# Create new payment requests with corrected amount ($55) for each deleted request

    receiver_email = req['receiver']['email']
    description = req['description']
    private = req['private']
    new_amount = req['amount'] - 15  # 70 - 15 = 55
    result = apis.venmo.create_payment_request(
        user_email=receiver_email,
        amount=new_amount,
        access_token=access_token,
        description=description,
        private=private
    )
    print(f"Created for {receiver_email}: {result}")
